reviews.classification: bounded mechanisms, histories and proof-gap reconciliation
reviews.disposition: The nine lenses answer bounded questions rather than claiming a whole-game audit. The 914 workbooks / 1,613 sheets / 277,971 nonempty rows and fresh method map are recovery inventories. Sixteen disassemblies are not sixteen fully understood behaviors. Compiled memory defaults (14 rows, count 10 and retention 100 years), ordinary five-calendar-year log pruning and the untouched vital-history branch have separate consumers; optional GZip/encryption proves neither active configuration nor whole-save bounds or crash safety. Eleven identifiable realm rows and 440 matching fields do not qualify full breakthrough payment/RNG/failure transactions. Sects, revival, ancient plans and auction intervals remain partly table evidence, with executable scheduling, childbirth, marriage, final selection and full price resolution open. Preserve the eight proposals and 22 touches. Historical installed-state wording is dated evidence, not a fresh check or uninstall instruction.
reviews.evidence: All JSON values and complete report text read; source-local distinctions compared. No transitive claim to underlying source or runtime review.

reviews.classification: bounded mechanisms, histories and proof-gap reconciliation
reviews.disposition: The selected fixed-item exchange distinguishes offer wording, selectable eligibility, uncertain commentary, learned word, solved inscription, shown-object history and actual donation. Refusal preserves an alternative, but menu-generation recent-offer mutation precedes it. Confirming a word does not solve the whole inscription; later exclusion tests shown rather than donated. All 34 external occurrences have located bindings, so the gaps concern actual inscription state, queue/tunnel/callback timing and serialization, not a missing selected external body. The 72 preserved containers / 8,434 tokens / 1,500 resolved literal destinations are structural counts, not executed paths or complete scene audits. Preserve missing-row/fallback handling without invented repairs or authoring line numbers. Keep six proposals/five touches optional and commercial story rights separate from MIT format reference and scoped CC0 notices.

ids: F1–F7; P1–P8; T1–T6; two exact source lineages
reviews.classification: bounded mechanisms, histories and proof-gap reconciliation
reviews.disposition: The original and community pins remain separate rulesets: direct spell XP, starting vigor, training furniture/upgrade, training curves, next-spell arcana surcharge and time banking differ. Payment queues vigor before later settlement; a full output cap can still consume stamina. In the community chain direct scaler XP does not invoke completion; a later payable training update crosses the capability threshold, resets overflow and reveals a method whose weapon means remain separate. Fine/coarse step affordability gives a boundary counterexample, not a measured whole-offline-loss result. Preserve full declared catalogues, named unread modules and not-loaded files separately; declaration counts are not effective runtime or semantic completion. Eight proposals and six touches stay optional. The exact user build, play/UI/pacing/save behavior and wider summon/combat/quest systems remain unverified.
